device: Apple Silicon Mac, Chrome (desktop A in the device matrix); tier desktop at 60 fps, the operator's sf bake (QA build)

steps.instruction: Bake the real city (pnpm map:build -- --area sf, then pnpm map:pack), build the QA bundle with the bake merged in (DV_WORLD=sf VITE_DV_QA=1 pnpm build) and serve it locally (pnpm --filter @dv/edge exec wrangler dev --port 8788).

In Chrome open http://localhost:8788/?perf=1&tier=desktop&scenario=route-ferry-ocean-beach&debug=1 with the look on (the default). The camera flies the 120 s route from the Ferry Building over Civic Center and the Sunset to Ocean Beach. When it ends tap Export and save perf.json and notes.json to docs/device-runs/M02e/mac/.

Informational, never a pass condition (GPU timing through trackTimestamp is UNVERIFIED on Chrome for macOS and per-node attribution is not in the ledger): run walk-civic-center at 13:00 clear several times and, from the debug panel, toggle each post node and the shadow pass off in turn; if the timestamp queries resolve, record the GPU ms of each, otherwise record the CPU frame-time delta of toggling it. Write the table into notes.json as nodeCost: { gtao-half, bloom, smaa, tonemap, shadows, lookOffTotal } in milliseconds.

Look at the real city with the look on and off (the look switch in the debug panel) at 13:00 clear, 19:00 golden and 22:00 clear and write the reviewer's verdict into notes.json as lookVerdict (one paragraph: what reads as a city now, what still reads as flat boxes). Optionally save a before/after image of the same viewpoint as docs/look/M02e-before-after-sf.png.

Run pnpm perf:verify -- docs/device-runs/M02e/mac/perf.json --tier desktop --checklist tools/ci/checklists/M02e-mac.json: median and p95 frame time, frames over 50 ms, render and triangle counts and the cold-download figure must pass.
